module purpose: neorv32_cpu_cp_cond decodes fields of the control record ctrl_i into a command-valid decision (lines 41-43) that it drives on valid_o (line 66), tests rs2_i for zero and combines that test with ctrl_i.ir_funct3(1) into a condition (lines 62-63), and on each rising edge of clk_i registers rs1_i on res_o when the command is valid and the condition holds, or zero otherwise (lines 52-56); rstn_i low clears res_o (lines 50-51).

use-case flows.value: command-valid decision: whether the current control-record fields (alu_cp_alu, ir_opcode(5), ir_funct3(2), ir_funct3(0), ir_funct12(11 downto 5)) request this conditional operation
condition decision: zero test of rs2_i combined by xnor with ctrl_i.ir_funct3(1)
conditional result: rs1_i registered on res_o when valid_cmd and condition are both '1', all zeros otherwise
command-valid indication driven on valid_o from valid_cmd
res_o cleared to all zeros while rstn_i is '0'

conceptual assets.concept: Conditional operation result -- the operand rs1_i or all zeros, chosen by the command-valid and condition decisions and delivered to the consumer of res_o
conceptual assets.reasoning: The result flow is `if (valid_cmd = '1') and (condition = '1') then res_o <= rs1_i; else res_o <= (others => '0');` (lines 53-56) on the edge of line 52 (res_o CLOCKED_BY clk_i at occurrences 3 and 4). res_o is delivered through an output port to a consumer that is not supplied, so Integrity is Established from lines 54 and 56: the consumer must receive exactly rs1_i when both decisions hold and zero otherwise. Availability is also Established under the implemented conditions: with rstn_i high, a new result is registered at every rising edge of clk_i and held until the next (lines 52-56). The zero arm (line 56) keeps rs1_i off res_o unless both decisions hold; this is recorded as part of the integrity relation, and confidentiality is not claimed because no line establishes who is entitled to the operand. res_o is an exit port (occurrence 3, COPIES rs1_i, line 54), taking precedence over its storage role (edge storage). rs1_i sets the value: this entity reads it to store it in res_o (occurrence 2, CARRIES res_o, line 54). valid_cmd and condition only gate this value (GATED_BY records on res_o at occurrences 3 and 4); they are reported under their own decision concepts, not here.

conceptual assets.concept: Condition decision -- whether the tested operand rs2_i meets the zero or non-zero condition chosen by ctrl_i.ir_funct3(1)
conceptual assets.reasoning: The module computes `rs2_zero <= '1' when (rs2_i = zero_c) else '0';` (line 62) and `condition <= rs2_zero xnor ctrl_i.ir_funct3(1);` (line 63), and the result flow depends on it: condition GATES res_o (occurrence 2, line 53), deciding between `res_o <= rs1_i;` (line 54) and the zero arm (line 56). Integrity is Established because a wrong decision makes res_o violate the implemented relation of lines 53-56 even when the command is valid. condition computes the decision (occurrence 3, DERIVES_FROM rs2_zero and ctrl_i.ir_funct3, line 63). rs2_i sets it: this entity reads it only to decide (occurrence 2, GATES rs2_zero, line 62; CONTROL-ONLY source in the flow graph). ctrl_i sets the polarity of the decision: the port is named whole, cited at its occurrence 7 on line 63, where its field ir_funct3 has the record SOURCES condition. rs2_zero is the zero test that is an operand of the xnor (line 63); it is part of the computation whose result is condition, so it is not listed as a separate reference. ctrl_i is a control record of decoded instruction fields, not a record carrying complete interconnect transactions, so the transport rule does not exclude it.
